correctness.rationale: C PASS: Every total perfect code on Q4 has exactly 4 vertices by open-neighborhood partition, inducing two disjoint edges. After translating chosen edge {0,ei}, mutual nonoverlap of open neighborhoods forces other edge {u,u+ei} with u=1111. Four directions times four cosets give 16 codes. Quotient by antipodal pairs has 8 vertices and exactly K4,4 edges; each code is full edge preimage. Intersections of codes are size 2 iff quotient edges incident, otherwise 0; legal double-swap graph equals L(K4,4)=K4 Cartesian K4, strongly regular (16,6,2,2), 48 edges, distances 0/1/2, two shortest 2-step paths, no single-swap. Matching count 4!=24 partitions, each code in 3!=6.
